newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends softer at 230.80/231.20 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends softer at 230.80/231.20 per dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 230.80-231.20 per dollar, softer than 230.50/60 in the morning, due to a slight rise in foreign currency demand on the local interbank market, dealers said.
"The lev retreated just beyond 231 (to the dollar) at the close, after foreign currency demand picked up in the afternoon," a commercial bank dealer said.
But volume remained small with foreign currency probably bid by a number of small final clients or a large importer sought a limited amount, traders said.
The central bank was seen selling dollars at market rates initially around 230.30 levs in the morning and at 230.70 in the afternoon, dealers said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
